_comment: Automation profile for the Pico HID rig. Lives at /profile.json on the device. The Pico loads it on boot and runs it autonomously. All coordinates are RAW HID units (0..32767); the Mac-side UI converts a display's macOS-point rectangle into these using the saved calibration. Edit via the UI, or copy this file to the CIRCUITPY drive while the jumper is OFF.
name: default
